title: Powers' LightSkinKeisha Reveals She Still Hasn't Met Executive Producer 50 Cent [Watch]
htmlContent:
LightSkinKeisha is an American rapper, singer, and songwriter who recently made an appearance on Power Book II: Ghost, a spinoff series of the popular Starz drama Power.

LightSkinKeisha, whose real name is Keisha White, played the role of a character named BruShandria Carmichael, a woman from the streets who has a connection to one of the show's main characters, Tariq St. Patrick, played by Michael Rainey Jr. Carmichael is described as being tough and street-smart, with a no-nonsense attitude that helps her survive in the dangerous world of drug dealing and organized crime.

While Lightskinkeisha's appearance on Power Book II: Ghost was her first acting role, she is no stranger to the entertainment industry. She first gained fame as a social media personality, thanks to her witty and often hilarious videos on platforms like Vine and Instagram. In 2017, she released her debut single, "Weather," which quickly gained popularity and helped her build a dedicated fanbase.

Since then, LightSkinKeisha has continued to make music and expand her brand. She has released several more singles and has collaborated with other artists like Kash Doll, Lil Yachty, and Blac Youngsta. She has also become a popular figure on social media, with over 2 million followers on Instagram alone.

LightSkinKeisha's appearance in Power Book II: Ghost was well-received by both fans and critics of the show. Many praised her performance, saying that she brought much-needed energy and authenticity to the role of BruShandria Carmichael. Some even speculated that her character could return in future episodes, given the unresolved storyline surrounding her relationship with Tariq.

Overall, LightSkinKeisha's appearance in Power Book II: Ghost was a significant moment in her career and helped to showcase her versatility as an entertainer. It remains to be seen what her next move will be, but one thing is for sure: she has made a name for herself in the entertainment industry and has a bright future ahead of her.

Speaking of Keisha, she was recently on The Crew Has It Podcast with Michael Rainey Jr & Gianni Paolo and revealed that she hasn't met 50 Cent yet.

During the episode, Paolo asked if 50 Cent was at her first table read, and Keisha responded, "I've not met 50 yet ."

Ghost season 3 is scheduled to debut on March 17th of, 2023.
